title: Design, synthesis, and apoptotic antiproliferative activity of novel dihydropyrimidine-5-carbonitrile/1,2,4-oxadiazole hybrids as dual EGFR/VEGFR-2 inhibitors endowed with antioxidant activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38998-39027
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05685C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lamya H. Al-Wahaibi, Amira M. Mohamed, Hesham A. Abou-Zied, Abdullah Yahya Abdullah Alzahrani, Stefan Bräse, Bahaa G. M. Youssif
A series of new dihydropyrimidine/1,2,4-oxadiazole compounds was designed and synthesised. Their structures were validated by IR, NMR, and elemental analysis, and they were evaluated as antiproliferative agents targeting EGFR and VEGFR-2.
